C_lts_matt_donnelly.name: Matt Donnelly
C_lts_matt_donnelly.core_wound: He expected adulthood to give him a role, a crew, a job people needed done; automation and managed systems left him adjacent to responsibility without much real agency.
C_lts_matt_donnelly.inland_life: Human oversight role around automated infrastructure systems. Important language, thin function. Not poor, not desperate, replaceable.
C_lts_matt_donnelly.what_the_reach_gives: Immediate usefulness, authority, gear logic, route decisions, people listening.
C_lts_matt_donnelly.fatal_flaw: Mistakes being deferred to for being trusted; protects the identity the Reach gives him instead of the people.
C_lts_matt_donnelly.arc: From passive redundancy to intoxicating usefulness to false leadership to humbled acceptance. Final growth: lets Ryan lead.
C_lts_matt_donnelly.voice: short, practical, blunt, defensive when challenged
C_lts_matt_donnelly.visual: solid frame, practical work jacket, worn boots, contractor bag, tide monitor clipped to strap; posture starts squared and performative, later subdued

C_lts_ryan_kelleher.name: Ryan Kelleher
C_lts_ryan_kelleher.core_wound: His marine knowledge still matters, but society has mostly moved past the working water culture that formed him.
C_lts_ryan_kelleher.inland_life: Repairs old marine equipment and obsolete boats; practical side work around a shrinking water world.
C_lts_ryan_kelleher.what_the_reach_gives: A place where tide, weather, mud, current, and judgment still matter.
C_lts_ryan_kelleher.fatal_flaw: Sees danger clearly but struggles to assert himself socially before consequences force the point.
C_lts_ryan_kelleher.arc: Practical guide, alienated conscience, rescuer who disappears, survivor who returns changed, quiet leader of the final crossing.
C_lts_ryan_kelleher.visual: weathered marine jacket, hood, waterproof layers, old boots, salt-stained practicality; moves less than others and reads water first

C_lts_chris_barlow.name: Chris Barlow
C_lts_chris_barlow.core_wound: Trained for a software future that evaporated into automated pipelines and ceremonial junior roles.
C_lts_chris_barlow.inland_life: Patchy low-stakes freelance technical work and unfinished personal projects; financially okay enough to make failure harder to name.
C_lts_chris_barlow.what_the_reach_gives: Material, stories, names, language, social attention, a world where observations matter.
C_lts_chris_barlow.fatal_flaw: Turns lived danger into story too quickly; makes fear entertaining and narratable.
C_lts_chris_barlow.arc: Funny observer to Reach mythmaker to ashamed witness who deletes much of the archive after tragedy becomes content.
C_lts_chris_barlow.voice: quick, ironic, deflective, funny until suddenly not
C_lts_chris_barlow.visual: layered hoodie or tech jacket, cracked tablet/recorder, battery packs, too many cables; underprepared physically, overprepared digitally

C_lts_justin_rourke.name: Justin Rourke
C_lts_justin_rourke.core_wound: He would have fit better in a crisis-oriented physical society; now he has energy and nerve with nowhere good to put them.
C_lts_justin_rourke.inland_life: Physical gigs, recreational risk, exercise, short training tracks, adrenaline hobbies; not lazy, undirected.
C_lts_justin_rourke.what_the_reach_gives: Audience, stakes, physical tests, attention that feels like identity.
C_lts_justin_rourke.fatal_flaw: Confuses being watched with being needed; escalates risk when attention rewards him.
C_lts_justin_rourke.arc: Comic energy to local runner status to emotional liability to collapse when risk has no audience.
C_lts_justin_rourke.visual: bigger frame, rescue vest or heavy outer layer, rope/climbing gear, scuffed boots, always moving; stillness after disaster is unsettling

C_lts_nicole_hanley.name: Nicole Hanley
C_lts_nicole_hanley.role: adult participant / Reach-fascinated member of the friend group
C_lts_nicole_hanley.core_wound: Inland life is too managed, scripted, safe, and pre-solved for her too. She is not a representative of stable land life; she is also underfelt and underused by the world she lives in.
C_lts_nicole_hanley.inland_life: Comfortable enough but emotionally insufficient. Her ordinary life has the same airless optimization problem as the others, even if she expresses the dissatisfaction differently.
C_lts_nicole_hanley.what_the_reach_gives: Unsupervised time, physical texture, danger, weirdness, adult social immediacy, and a place that has not already been solved for her.
C_lts_nicole_hanley.fatal_flaw: Can be pulled into the same bad momentum as the others while telling herself she is only curious or along for the ride.
C_lts_nicole_hanley.arc: Fascinated participant in the Reach culture; her presence helps keep the group socially adult and emotionally plausible, while she remains fully tempted by the place herself.
C_lts_nicole_hanley.voice: casual, grounded, dry, specific; never an exposition machine or philosophical decoder
C_lts_nicole_hanley.visual: practical waterproof layers, compact gear, gloves, folded maps or small useful items when needed; adult, comfortable in the group, not theatrical and not positioned as a scold

calibration.locked_rule: Nicole is not the explainer, the competent scold, the Velma figure, the moral judge, or the adult-in-the-room corrective device.
calibration.belongs_because: She likes being there and wants the Reach for herself.
calibration.social_function: Her presence prevents the story from becoming juvenile men acting out boyhood fantasies, not because she corrects them, but because she makes the group feel like adults with mixed histories, attraction, jokes, trust, embarrassment, and real familiarity.
calibration.rare_but_plausible: She is not meant to represent most women. She is one of the women who plausibly would say yes to this group and this place.
calibration.writing_rule: Use her to participate before using her to interpret. She may notice things casually, but exposition must not collapse into her dialogue.
avoid: I am surrounded by idiots energy
sample_lines: That sign wasn’t there last time.
I kind of like it here. Which is probably bad.
No, I’m not climbing that. I’m not stupid tonight.
This place is awful. I want to see the rest of it.
You guys are making it weird. It was already weird.
I’m not explaining this. I’m just saying I want to know where that stairwell goes.

C_lts_kevin_marsh.name: Kevin Marsh
C_lts_kevin_marsh.core_wound: Trained in risk, forecasting, or insurance systems where judgment should matter; automated models made him redundant in slow motion.
C_lts_kevin_marsh.inland_life: Monitors automated risk systems and exception reviews that mostly correct themselves.
C_lts_kevin_marsh.what_the_reach_gives: Risk with teeth; a place where forecasts and probabilities matter again.
C_lts_kevin_marsh.fatal_flaw: Right too softly; lets social pressure override certainty.
C_lts_kevin_marsh.arc: Anxious calculator to person who articulates the book's diagnosis: the Reach did not make them alive; it made them impossible to ignore.
C_lts_kevin_marsh.voice: technical when anxious, plain when emotionally clear
C_lts_kevin_marsh.visual: layered rain gear, tablet/tide device, small weather sensor, nervous posture, often looking at sky/water while others look at each other
